_about: T21: the Tiro day's own timings (prologue, ritual, bout intros, aftermath). Session pacing only, no combat number. The ritual's hold is teach.json offerHoldS (docs/campaign/04-vr-campaign-design.md section 3). A missing or bad file fails the day (BeginArc). T28 set prologueMaxS, introS, aftermathTabletS and closingCardS from the C2 time budget (docs/campaign/05-c2-slice-story-bible-and-script.md section 4); each beat's floor (the earliest its skip works) and the intermission scenes are in story/slice.json.
_prologueMaxS: Card T21: the first-launch prologue is a static tableau, skippable by palming the centre stone. T28: 10 -> 45, the prologue beat's max in C2 section 4 (floor 6 s, natural 36 s); the centre stone skips from the floor (slice.json beats prologue.floorS).
_ritualLineS: How long Warden Septima's line stands before the offer line replaces it (one line at a time, docs/campaign/04-vr-campaign-design.md section 2). Placeholder pacing until the C2 cue sheet and its voice lines set the real length.
_ritualTimeoutS: Card T21: 'a soft timeout of 20 s continues anyway'. Counted from the start of the ritual, the same 20 s as the never-blocking stone choices (V2-ROADMAP row 14).
_introS: Each bout opens on one intro line on the dais rail while the opponents stand on the sand; the kernel steps only after it. T28: 3 -> one length per Tiro wave index, C2 section 4 beats 3, 5, 7 and 9 (natural = max: 8, 8, 12, 12 s). A single number still means every bout.
_aftermathTabletS: The aftermath first shows the tablet with its heading line, then the closing line (card T21: 'a greybox stone tablet ... then the closing placeholder line'). Palming the centre stone ends the day only once the closing line stands. T28: 4 -> 16, the tablet beat's natural dwell in C2 section 4 (floor 5, max 18; the tablet itself has no skip).
_closingCardS: T28, new: the closing card (C2 section 4 beat 11: floor 6, natural 31, max 34 s), counted from the end of the tablet. The centre stone ends the day from the closing beat's floor (slice.json beats closing.floorS); at closingCardS the day closes itself, so no beat waits for the player.
